summary.name: VSCO
summary.one_liner: VSCO is a connected photography ecosystem for editing photos and video, sharing work in a community, building a portfolio site, and running a photography business.
use_cases: Editing photos in bulk with presets
Managing client bookings and payments as a freelance photographer
Sharing work in a photography community
summary.what_it_does: The page describes VSCO as a connected system for photographers spanning capture, editing, community and business management. Editing tools include a photo editor with presets, filters, effects, batch editing, an AI photo editor, and a video editor. VSCO Canvas provides moodboards, and VSCO Spaces hosts shared galleries. For business use, VSCO Workspace is described as studio management software, alongside VSCO Hub for client connections, client galleries, and a portfolio site that syncs with the VSCO Profile. The photo editor is listed for iPhone, Android, and desktop web on Mac and PC.
notable: Full photography ecosystem: editor, community, portfolio site, client galleries and studio management in one service
Free membership tier (Starter) with 15 presets, with paid Pro and VSCO One tiers
Mentorship from The Freelance Photographer and video education library (VSCO One)
caveats: VSCO One and VSCO Pro are available on iOS and desktop only
Pro and One tiers are paid upgrades over the free Starter membership; exact prices not stated on the page
Some features such as full batch editing and unlimited galleries are tied to the higher tiers
